description: A maximal member on a directive other than elidable (engine §9).
A maximal member whose value is false (engine §9).
A maximal member whose value is the string true (engine §9).
A maximal member whose value is null (engine §9).
A maximal member whose value is the number 1, which is not true, also in a language where 1 equals true (engine §9).
A maximal elidable directive with no arguments, as %elidable maximal gives (docs/output.md).
A maximal elidable directive whose argument is maximal, as %elidable maximal ~maximal gives (docs/output.md).
A plain elidable directive whose argument is maximal, as %elidable ~maximal gives (docs/output.md).
A maximal elidable directive with an unknown member. A library ignores a member of a directive that it does not know, and checks the members that it knows (docs/output.md).
An unknown member does not excuse a malformed known member: maximal on ambiguity-resolution stays malformed (docs/output.md, engine §9).
